why: studies/engineering/wheel_friction_intervention.json establishes that world-fixed friction axes cause the collapse, from five headings on the assembled robot at one rate. Two things it does not establish are needed before the ADR 0007 decision can be costed. First, the shape of the curve between the samples: a narrow notch at +/-90 and a broad degradation have very different consequences for a confirmatory design that routes in all directions. Second, whether the detached pod is affected. Gate 0 item 1 has two halves and the detached half has never been run at any heading but the spawn one, so the claim that every recorded figure is heading-dependent is measured for the assembly and inferred for the pod. They share the articulated_pod wheel template, so the inference is reasonable, but it is an inference.
no_platform_change: The model tree is unmodified for every run here. This measures the platform as every committed figure was collected on it.

protocol.obstruction_free_world: The straight stage must measure traction, not geometry. In the retained smoke world the straight stage reaches 0.7397 m at heading 0, 0.5830 m at +/-90 and 0.2238 m at 180, and the last of those is an obstruction rather than a traction effect. The assembled runs therefore use indoor_doorway.sdf with its six wall models removed and nothing else changed: the same ground plane, which declares no friction and so runs at the SDF default of 1.0, and the same spawn position (1.0, 2.75, 0.18). The detached-pod world already contains only a ground plane and the pod, so it is used unchanged.

assembled.rate_choice: 0.35 rad/s is the rate Gate 0 item 1 was collected at, so the rotation and travel columns are directly comparable with the committed figures. The rate sweep already showed no rate dependence between 0.20 and 0.35, and the collapse has been measured at 0.271, so this also tests it at the gate's own rate.
assembled.pose: imposed with gz set_pose at the spawn position, settled before the declared stage sequence

detached.pose: imposed on the self_mobile_pod model at its spawn position

protocol.hygiene: one simulator only; each case aborts unless the simulator process count is zero beforehand, and tears down afterwards

predictions_declared_before_running.assembled: Rotation authority and straight travel both vary with a 180-degree period, full near 0 and 180 and collapsing near 90. The shape between is not predicted: an elliptical combination of mu 1.2 and mu2 0.08 would fall off slowly and collapse only very near 90, while a sharper transition would mean a wider band of unusable headings.
predictions_declared_before_running.detached: The detached pod shows the same dependence, since its wheels come from the same template. If it does not, the reach of the defect is narrower than currently stated and the detached half of Gate 0 item 1 survives a repair unchanged.
predictions_declared_before_running.what_would_surprise: Any asymmetry between a heading and its 180-degree partner, which world-fixed friction axes cannot produce.
